title: Built on our own products first
lede: Two products we designed, built and shipped in-house. Not client logos, not slideware: working products we build and run ourselves. They make one clear point: we ship AI-first products to production, fast, and built to launch.

items.name: Bloop
items.kind: Own product · in build and launch
items.oneLiner: An AI events concierge for Bologna.
items.summary: A product we are building and launching right now. Bloop runs a live conversational concierge over a catalogue of what is on in the city. You ask in plain language and get a grounded answer over live data, not a list of search results.
items.tagline: An AI events concierge for Bologna.
items.built: A chat concierge on top of a live catalogue of what's on in the city. You ask in plain language and get answers from live event data, not a list of search results.
items.proves: We can take a new kind of AI product to production, on live data.

items.name: Washiiba
items.oneLiner: A complete laundry marketplace, mobile and web from one codebase.
items.summary: A complete, production-grade marketplace built end to end. Customer and provider flows, a managed backend, and mobile and web all from a single codebase.
items.tagline: A laundry marketplace on web and mobile from one codebase.
items.built: Customer and provider apps with ordering, pickup windows and live order status, plus an admin backend, on web and mobile from a single codebase.
items.proves: We can build a full two-sided marketplace across web and mobile, ready for the app stores.
